title: Kalkschuttfächer A
description: Dichter Kalkschuttfächer mit 320 einzigartigen Bruchstücken: drei geneigte, zwischen mittleren Steinen eingebettete Schichtplatten, ein gefallener Großblock, 76 mittlere Steine und 240 Splitter mit ausdünnendem Schuttfuß. Zahlreiche Schnittflächen, sekundäre Muschelbrüche, flache Bruchstufen und kräftige Kantenabplatzer gliedern die Oberflächen. Warme Kreide- und Ockertöne, sichtbare Bänderungen und dunkle erdige Basisspalten verbinden den aufgebankten Schutt mit den Canyonfelsen.

review.notes: Round 1. The size spread and the big leaning slabs are a good start, and the scale figure reads. Defects: every stone is the same rounded faceted potato with soft edges and a few round dimples (closeup_base); STYLE.md scree is angular, freshly broken chalk with sharp fracture faces. Fix: angular plate and wedge fragments with flat fracture faces and crisp edges, rounded only on older stones. No fall line: the pile is a flat heap with the large slabs at the back and small stones on top; real scree has a talus slope with the largest blocks rolled furthest down and fines up at the source. Fix: build a sloped cone (30-35 degrees) with size grading downslope. No ground contact: stones sit on the bare ground plane with no fines, sand or gravel bed between them and dark empty gaps between stones (closeup_base, hero.jpg). Fix: add a fine gravel/sand bed under and between the stones, partly burying the lower ones, plus a few grass tufts at the edges. Material: one uniform grey-beige on every stone with no light fresh fracture faces vs darker weathered faces. Fix: per-stone variation, light fresh breaks, darker lichen-stained older tops.
